      13      tax climate in the state of New York, with tax

      16      middle-class taxpayers; as well as the property-tax

      20      first two years.  As the cap goes forward, the

      21      savings will grow substantially greater.

      23      make our system competitive with other states.

      24             The purpose of these hearings is to develop

      25      recommendations for the upcoming budget cycle, since

       6             Our tax codes is far too complex.
